suite: V2.4.7 — Native Billing Bridge Stabilization & Android Build
note: V2.4.7 adds 16 new suites on top of V2.4.6's 105: bridge contract consistency (successful purchase, USER_CANCELED, pending, billing unavailable, queryPurchases array, consumePurchase, callback ID uniqueness, error JSON structure, Base64 transport safety, unresolved purchase recovery, timeout prevention, duplicate callback prevention, destroy cleanup), WebView security (URL scheme+host validation, intent URL validation), and PayPal flow unchanged verification. Native bridge stabilized: JS shim injected via WebView onPageStarted wraps @JavascriptInterface methods in Promises with 120s timeout, Base64 transport replaces fragile string escaping, ConcurrentHashMap tracks active callbacks, unresolved purchases stored for recovery. BillingClient v7 PendingPurchasesParams applied. WebView hardened: scheme+host origin validation, intent URL validation, PayPal opened in external browser, usesCleartextTraffic=false. Gradle wrapper JAR generated. Android build blocked by missing Android SDK and AGP plugin resolution — documented as external prerequisite.
